deft.ex: The surgeon's deft hands made the complex operation look easy.

dehydration.exZh: 天氣炎熱時，脫水可能導致頭痛和疲倦。

delete.exZh: 請刪除你不再需要的檔案以釋放空間。

deliberately.exZh: 他在會議上刻意避而不談這個問題。

dictator.exZh: 這名獨裁者統治這個國家超過三十年。

install.ex: Technicians will install solar panels on the school roof.
install.exZh: 技師將在學校屋頂安裝太陽能板。

instant.exZh: 軟體對每個問題都立刻給出回應。

instinct.ex: Birds migrate south by instinct when winter approaches.
instinct.exZh: 冬天將至時，鳥類憑本能向南遷徙。

instruct.ex: The coach will instruct the players on the new tactics.
instruct.exZh: 教練將指示球員新的戰術。

instruction.ex: Follow the instruction on the label before taking the medicine.
instruction.exZh: 服藥前請遵照標籤上的指示。

instructor.ex: The driving instructor told him to check the mirror.
instructor.exZh: 駕駛教練叫他檢查後照鏡。

insufficient.ex: Insufficient sleep can reduce students' concentration.
insufficient.exZh: 睡眠不足會降低學生的專注力。

insult.ex: It is an insult to call a hard-working colleague lazy.
insult.exZh: 說一個勤奮的同事懶惰是一種侮辱。

insurance.ex: Travellers should buy insurance to cover medical costs abroad.
insurance.exZh: 旅客應購買保險以涵蓋國外的醫療費用。

insurmountable.ex: The language barrier seemed insurmountable at first.
insurmountable.exZh: 起初語言障礙似乎是不可逾越的。

integrity.ex: The judge was respected for his honesty and integrity.
integrity.exZh: 這位法官因其誠實與正直而受到敬重。

intelligence.ex: Intelligence is not only measured by exam scores.
intelligence.exZh: 智慧並非只能用考試成績來衡量。

intelligent.ex: She is an intelligent student who learns very quickly.
intelligent.exZh: 她是個學得很快的聰明學生。

intense.ex: The intense heat made it hard to work outdoors.
intense.exZh: 熾熱的高溫使人難以在戶外工作。

intensive.ex: He was moved to the intensive care ward after the surgery.
intensive.exZh: 手術後他被轉入重症病房。

interact.ex: Children learn to interact with others through play.
interact.exZh: 孩子透過遊戲學習與他人互動。

interaction.ex: There was little interaction between the two departments.
interaction.exZh: 兩個部門之間幾乎沒有交集。

intercept.ex: The police managed to intercept the truck at the border.
intercept.exZh: 警方成功在邊境攔截了那輛卡車。

interest.ex: The bank pays interest on every savings account.
interest.exZh: 銀行對每個儲蓄帳戶支付利息。

interested.ex: He is interested in learning about marine biology.
interested.exZh: 他對學習海洋生物學感興趣。

interesting.ex: The lecture on ancient maps was really interesting.
interesting.exZh: 關於古地圖的講座真的很有趣。

interfere.ex: Parents should not interfere in their children's career choices.
interfere.exZh: 父母不應干涉孩子的職業選擇。

intern.ex: The intern helped the engineers test the new software.
intern.exZh: 實習生協助工程師測試新軟體。

international.ex: The city hosts an international film festival every autumn.
international.exZh: 這座城市每年秋天都舉辦國際影展。

interpersonal.ex: Good interpersonal skills are essential for team leaders.
interpersonal.exZh: 良好的人際技巧對團隊領導者而言不可或缺。

interpret.ex: She was hired to interpret the speech into three languages.
interpret.exZh: 她受僱將演講翻譯成三種語言。

interpreter.ex: The interpreter helped the delegates understand each other.
interpreter.exZh: 口譯員幫助代表們彼此理解。

interrupt.ex: It is rude to interrupt someone while they are speaking.
interrupt.exZh: 別人說話時打斷他們是不禮貌的。

intersect.ex: The two roads intersect near the old market.
intersect.exZh: 這兩條路在老市場附近交匯。

intervene.ex: The government decided to intervene to stop the price rises.
intervene.exZh: 政府決定介入以遏止物價上漲。

interview.ex: A journalist will interview the mayor about the new policy.
interview.exZh: 一名記者將就新政策採訪市長。

intimate.ex: They shared an intimate dinner in a small family restaurant.
intimate.exZh: 他們在一家小小的家庭餐廳共進溫馨的晚餐。

intimidate.ex: Bullies often try to intimidate younger students.
intimidate.exZh: 霸凌者常常試圖恐嚇低年級學生，使他們畏懼。

intoxicated.ex: The intoxicated driver was stopped by police at midnight.
intoxicated.exZh: 醉酒的駕駛人在午夜被警方攔下。

intrigue.ex: The mysterious letter began to intrigue her and sparked her curiosity.
intrigue.exZh: 那封神祕的信開始引起她的好奇，激起了她的興趣。

introduce.ex: The teacher will introduce the new student to the class.
introduce.exZh: 老師將向全班介紹這位新同學。

introvert.ex: As an introvert, he prefers reading to going to parties.
introvert.exZh: 身為內向的人，他寧可讀書也不愛參加派對。

intrude.ex: Please do not intrude on their private conversation.
intrude.exZh: 請不要闖入他們的私人談話。

intuition.ex: Her intuition told her that something was wrong with the deal.
intuition.exZh: 她的直覺告訴她這筆交易有問題。

inventory.ex: The shop checks its inventory every Friday evening.
inventory.exZh: 這家店每週五晚上盤點庫存。

invest.ex: Many young people invest a small part of their salary in shares.
invest.exZh: 許多年輕人把薪水的一小部分投資於股票。

investigate.ex: Officials will investigate the cause of the factory fire.
investigate.exZh: 官員將調查這起工廠火災的原因。

investigative.ex: Investigative journalism exposed corruption in the city council.
investigative.exZh: 調查性報導揭露了市議會的貪腐。

investment.ex: Education is a long-term investment in a country's future.
investment.exZh: 教育是對國家未來的長期投資。

investor.ex: The investor bought shares in a promising technology start-up.
investor.exZh: 這位投資人買進了一家前景看好的科技新創公司的股份。

invincible.ex: The champions believed they were invincible until they lost.
invincible.exZh: 冠軍隊伍在落敗前一直認為自己是不可戰勝的。

invisible.ex: Germs are invisible to the naked eye.

invite.ex: We plan to invite all our neighbours to the school festival.
invite.exZh: 我們打算邀請所有鄰居參加學校的園遊會。

involuntary.ex: Blinking is an involuntary action that protects the eyes.
involuntary.exZh: 眨眼是保護眼睛的不由自主的動作。

ipo.ex: The company's IPO raised millions of dollars for expansion.
ipo.exZh: 這家公司的首次公開募股為擴張籌集了數百萬美元。

ironic.ex: It is ironic that the fire station was destroyed by a fire.
ironic.exZh: 消防局竟毀於火災，實在諷刺。

irony.ex: The irony of the situation was that the lifeguard could not swim.
irony.exZh: 這情況的諷刺之處在於救生員不會游泳。

irrational.ex: Fear of harmless spiders can be completely irrational.
irrational.exZh: 對無害的蜘蛛感到害怕可能完全是非理性的。

irregular.ex: He has an irregular sleeping pattern due to shift work.
irregular.exZh: 由於輪班工作，他的作息很不規律。

irrelevant.ex: Your age is irrelevant to whether you can apply for the course.
irrelevant.exZh: 你的年齡與能否申請這門課無關緊要。

irreplaceable.ex: The antique vase was an irreplaceable family treasure.
irreplaceable.exZh: 那只古董花瓶是無可替代的傳家寶。

irrigation.ex: Modern irrigation systems save water on large farms.
irrigation.exZh: 現代灌溉系統讓大型農場節省用水。

irritable.ex: Lack of sleep made him irritable and impatient.
irritable.exZh: 睡眠不足使他變得煩躁又沒耐心。

irritate.ex: Constant noise from the building site began to irritate the residents.
irritate.exZh: 工地不斷傳出的噪音開始惹惱居民，令他們煩躁。

island.ex: The tourists took a ferry to the small island.
island.exZh: 遊客搭乘渡輪前往那座小島。

isolation.ex: Long periods of isolation can seriously affect mental health.
isolation.exZh: 長時間的孤獨會嚴重影響心理健康。

issue.ex: Air pollution is a serious issue in many large cities.
issue.exZh: 空氣污染在許多大城市是個嚴重的問題。

istanbul.ex: Istanbul lies on both the European and Asian sides of the Bosphorus.
istanbul.exZh: 伊斯坦布爾位於博斯普魯斯海峽的歐亞兩岸。

item.ex: Please check that every item on the list has been packed.
item.exZh: 請確認清單上的每個項目都已打包。

itinerary.ex: Our itinerary includes three days in Kyoto and two in Osaka.
itinerary.exZh: 我們的日程包括在京都三天、大阪兩天。

iv drip.ex: The nurse connected an IV drip to the weak patient's arm.
iv drip.exZh: 護理師為虛弱的病人手臂接上點滴。

ivory.ex: She wore an ivory dress to the ceremony.
ivory.exZh: 她穿著象牙色的洋裝出席典禮。

jab.ex: The boxer threw a quick jab and then stepped back.
jab.exZh: 拳擊手快速打出一記刺拳後退了一步。

jacket.ex: Take a jacket because it gets cold at night.
jacket.exZh: 帶件外套，因為晚上會變冷。

jade.ex: The museum displays beautiful jade from the Han dynasty.
jade.exZh: 博物館展出漢朝精美的玉器。

jail.ex: He spent two years in jail for fraud.
jail.exZh: 他因詐欺罪坐了兩年牢。

jam.ex: A traffic jam delayed the buses by nearly an hour.
jam.exZh: 交通堵塞使公車延誤了將近一小時。

janitor.ex: The school janitor locks all the doors at six o'clock.
janitor.exZh: 學校的清潔工在六點鎖上所有的門。

january.ex: January is the coldest month in many northern countries.
january.exZh: 一月是許多北方國家最冷的月份。

japanese.ex: They ate at a small Japanese restaurant near the station.
japanese.exZh: 他們在車站附近一家小小的日式餐廳用餐。

jasmine.ex: Jasmine tea is popular in many Chinese households.
jasmine.exZh: 茉莉花茶在許多華人家庭中很受歡迎。

jaw.ex: The boxer broke his jaw in the final round.
jaw.exZh: 拳擊手在最後一回合傷到了下巴。

jazz.ex: Live jazz played in the café every Friday night.
jazz.exZh: 每週五晚上咖啡廳都有現場爵士樂演奏。

jealous.ex: She felt jealous when her friend received the scholarship.
jealous.exZh: 朋友獲得獎學金時，她感到嫉妒。

jet.ex: The jet landed safely after a nine-hour flight.
jet.exZh: 這架飛機在飛行九小時後平安降落。

jewel.ex: The crown was decorated with a rare blue jewel.
jewel.exZh: 王冠上鑲著一顆稀有的藍寶石。

jewelry.ex: She keeps her jewelry in a locked wooden box.
jewelry.exZh: 她把珠寶放在上鎖的木盒裡。

job.ex: He found a job in a local software company.
job.exZh: 他在一家本地軟體公司找到了工作。

jog.ex: She likes to jog around the lake before breakfast.
jog.exZh: 她喜歡早餐前繞著湖慢跑。

joke.ex: He likes to joke with his classmates between lessons.
joke.exZh: 他喜歡在課堂之間跟同學開玩笑。

journalism.ex: She studied journalism at university and now writes for a newspaper.
journalism.exZh: 她在大學主修新聞學，現在為報社撰稿。

journalist.ex: The journalist interviewed survivors of the earthquake.
journalist.exZh: 記者採訪了地震的倖存者。

joy.ex: The children shouted with joy when they saw the snow.
joy.exZh: 孩子們看到雪時開心地大叫。

joyful.ex: The joyful crowd danced in the streets after the victory.
joyful.exZh: 勝利後，歡欣的人群在街上跳舞。

judge.ex: It is unfair to judge a person by their appearance.
judge.exZh: 以貌取人來判斷一個人是不公平的。

judgment.ex: Good judgment is essential when making financial decisions.
judgment.exZh: 做財務決策時，良好的判斷力是必要的。

judicial.ex: The judicial system must treat all citizens equally.
judicial.exZh: 法律體系必須平等對待所有公民。

jump.ex: The children love to jump on the trampoline.
jump.exZh: 孩子們喜歡在彈跳床上跳。

junior.ex: He started as a junior engineer straight after graduation.
junior.exZh: 他一畢業就從初級工程師做起。

justice.ex: Everyone should have equal access to justice.
justice.exZh: 每個人都應能平等地獲得正義。

keen.ex: She is keen on photography and joins the camera club.
keen.exZh: 她熱衷於攝影，並加入了攝影社。

keep.ex: Keep trying even when the task seems difficult.
keep.exZh: 即使任務看似困難，也要堅持嘗試。

kennel.ex: The dog sleeps in a wooden kennel in the garden.
kennel.exZh: 這隻狗睡在花園裡的木製狗舍中。

kenya.ex: Kenya attracts tourists who want to see wildlife on safari.
kenya.exZh: 肯尼亞吸引想在野生動物園觀賞野生動物的遊客。

key.ex: The piano's black key produces a lower sound.
key.exZh: 鋼琴的黑色琴鍵會發出較低的聲音。

keyboard.ex: He bought a new keyboard to type faster.
keyboard.exZh: 他買了新鍵盤，打字更快。

keychain.ex: She attached a small keychain to her school bag.
keychain.exZh: 她在書包上掛了一個小鑰匙扣。

kick.ex: It is cruel to kick someone when they are down.
kick.exZh: 對處境不佳的人落井下石是殘忍的。

kid.ex: Every kid in the village walks to school.
kid.exZh: 村裡的每個孩子都走路上學。

kidney.ex: The kidney filters waste from the blood.
kidney.exZh: 腎臟會過濾血液中的廢物。

kill.ex: The traffic noise here is killing me, so I can't sleep.
kill.exZh: 這裡的交通噪音快要了我的命，我根本睡不著。

kiln.ex: The potter fired the bowls in a large kiln.
kiln.exZh: 陶藝家把碗放進大窯裡燒製。

kilogram.ex: A kilogram of rice costs about fifty dollars.
kilogram.exZh: 一公斤米大約要五十元。

kilometer.ex: The marathon route is exactly forty-two kilometers long.
kilometer.exZh: 馬拉松路線全長剛好四十二公里。

kind.ex: A kind stranger helped her carry the heavy bags upstairs.
kind.exZh: 一位善良的陌生人幫她把沉重的袋子搬上樓。

kindergarten.ex: Children in kindergarten learn through play and storytelling.
kindergarten.exZh: 幼兒園的孩子透過遊戲和說故事來學習。

kindle.ex: The speech helped kindle public interest in renewable energy.
kindle.exZh: 這場演講燃起了大眾對再生能源的興趣。

kindness.ex: The nurse's kindness made the patients feel much less anxious.
kindness.exZh: 護理師的善良讓病患不再那麼焦慮。

kintsugi.ex: Kintsugi repairs broken pottery with gold, treating cracks as part of its history.
kintsugi.exZh: 金繕用黃金修補破裂的陶器，把裂痕視為歷史的一部分。

kiss.ex: She gave her grandmother a gentle kiss on the cheek.
kiss.exZh: 她輕輕吻了奶奶的臉頰。

kit.ex: Every hiker should carry a basic first-aid kit.
kit.exZh: 每位登山客都應該攜帶基本的急救工具包。

kitchen.ex: The restaurant's kitchen must follow strict hygiene regulations.
kitchen.exZh: 這家餐廳的廚房必須遵守嚴格的衛生規定。

kitten.ex: The rescued kitten slowly learned to trust people again.
kitten.exZh: 被救起的小貓慢慢學會再次信任人類。

knead.ex: You need to knead the dough for ten minutes before baking.
knead.exZh: 烘焙前你需要把麵糰揉十分鐘。

knee.ex: The footballer had surgery on his knee after the injury.
knee.exZh: 這名足球員受傷後膝蓋動了手術。

kneel.ex: Visitors must kneel before entering the small shrine.
kneel.exZh: 訪客在進入小神龕前必須下跪。

knife.ex: Always keep the knife sharp to avoid accidents while cooking.
knife.exZh: 烹飪時要保持刀子鋒利以免發生意外。

knit.ex: My grandmother likes to knit warm scarves for the winter.
knit.exZh: 我奶奶喜歡在冬天織溫暖的圍巾。

knock.ex: Please knock before entering the manager's office.
knock.exZh: 進入經理辦公室前請先敲門。

knock down.ex: The strong wind could knock down several old trees.
knock down.exZh: 強風可能會吹倒好幾棵老樹。

know.ex: I know the answer to the question about climate change.
know.exZh: 我知道這個關於氣候變遷的問題的答案。

knowledge.ex: Reading widely is a good way to broaden your knowledge.
knowledge.exZh: 廣泛閱讀是拓展知識的好方法。

knuckle.ex: He hurt his knuckle while repairing the bicycle.
knuckle.exZh: 他修腳踏車時弄傷了指關節。

label.ex: Check the label to see whether the food contains nuts.
label.exZh: 看一下標籤確認食物是否含有堅果。

labor.ex: Manual labor in the heat can be dangerous without enough water.
labor.exZh: 在高溫下從事勞動，沒有足夠的水可能很危險。

laboratory.ex: Students must wear goggles when working in the laboratory.
laboratory.exZh: 學生在實驗室工作時必須戴護目鏡。

lacquer.ex: The craftsman covered the wooden box with a layer of red lacquer.
lacquer.exZh: 工匠在木盒上塗了一層紅漆。

lady.ex: The kind lady next door often waters our plants.
lady.exZh: 隔壁那位親切的阿姨常常幫我們澆花。

land.ex: The plane will land at the airport in twenty minutes.
land.exZh: 飛機將在二十分鐘後降落在機場。

landlord.ex: The landlord agreed to repair the broken heater.
landlord.exZh: 房東同意修理壞掉的暖氣。

landmark.ex: The old clock tower is the best-known landmark in the city.
landmark.exZh: 古老的鐘塔是這座城市最著名的地標。

landscape.ex: The artist's landscape captured the mist over the mountains.
landscape.exZh: 這位藝術家的風景畫捕捉了山間的薄霧。

landslide.ex: Heavy rain triggered a landslide that blocked the mountain road.
landslide.exZh: 大雨引發山體滑坡，堵住了山路。

language.ex: Learning a second language improves memory and creativity.
language.exZh: 學習第二語言能增進記憶力和創造力。

lap.ex: The child fell asleep on his mother's lap.
lap.exZh: 孩子在媽媽的腿上睡著了。

laptop.ex: She works on her laptop at the library every afternoon.
laptop.exZh: 她每天下午都在圖書館用筆記型電腦工作。

laser.ex: Doctors use a laser to correct certain eye problems.
laser.exZh: 醫生用雷射來矯正某些眼睛問題。

late.ex: The late professor left his library to the university.
late.exZh: 已故的教授把他的藏書留給了大學。

latent.ex: Many viruses remain latent in the body for years.
latent.exZh: 許多病毒會在體內潛伏多年。

latin.ex: Many medical terms come from Latin roots.
latin.exZh: 許多醫學術語源自拉丁語詞根。

latte.ex: He orders a hot latte before every morning lecture.
latte.exZh: 他每次早上上課前都會點一杯熱拿鐵。

laugh.ex: The audience began to laugh at the comedian's joke.
laugh.exZh: 觀眾聽到喜劇演員的笑話開始笑了。

laughter.ex: Laughter can help reduce stress and improve your mood.
laughter.exZh: 笑聲能幫助減輕壓力並改善心情。

launch.ex: The company will launch its new app next month.
launch.exZh: 公司將於下個月推出新的應用程式。

lavender.ex: Lavender oil is often used to help people sleep better.
lavender.exZh: 薰衣草精油常被用來幫助睡眠。

lawsuit.ex: The residents filed a lawsuit against the polluting factory.
lawsuit.exZh: 居民對這家汙染的工廠提起訴訟。

lawyer.ex: She hired a lawyer to review the contract.
lawyer.exZh: 她請了一位律師審閱合約。

layer.ex: The mountain was covered with a thick layer of snow.
layer.exZh: 山上覆蓋著一層厚厚的雪。

lazy.ex: He felt too lazy to leave the sofa on Sunday.

lead.ex: Old water pipes may contain lead, which is harmful to health.

peaceful.exZh: 這座村莊很平靜，幾乎沒有什麼車流。

peak.ex: The company reached its peak of success in the early two thousands.
peak.exZh: 這家公司在二〇〇〇年代初期達到了事業的巔峰。

pearl.ex: Divers collected pearls from the warm waters near the island.
pearl.exZh: 潛水員在島嶼附近的溫暖海域採集珍珠。

pebble.ex: The child threw a pebble into the lake and watched the ripples.
pebble.exZh: 孩子把一顆鵝卵石丟進湖裡，看著漣漪擴散。

peculiar.ex: The soup had a peculiar taste that nobody could describe.
peculiar.exZh: 這碗湯有一種沒有人說得出來的奇怪味道。

pediatric.ex: She works in the pediatric ward of the city hospital.
pediatric.exZh: 她在市立醫院的兒科病房工作。

peer.ex: The students peered at the microscope to see the tiny cells.
peer.exZh: 學生們凝視著顯微鏡，想看清楚微小的細胞。

pen.ex: Please sign the contract with a blue pen.
pen.exZh: 請用藍色的筆在合約上簽名。

penalty.ex: Drivers face a heavy penalty if they ignore the speed limit.
penalty.exZh: 駕駛人若無視速限，將面臨重罰。

pencil.ex: The architect sketched the first design with a soft pencil.
pencil.exZh: 建築師用軟質鉛筆畫出了第一份設計草圖。

pendant.ex: She wore a silver pendant that her grandmother had given her.
pendant.exZh: 她戴著祖母送給她的銀色吊墜。

penetrate.ex: Sunlight cannot penetrate the deepest parts of the ocean.
penetrate.exZh: 陽光無法穿透海洋最深的區域。

penniless.ex: After losing his job, he was left penniless and had to rely on friends.
penniless.exZh: 失業後，他身無分文，只能依靠朋友。

penthouse.ex: The businessman bought a penthouse overlooking the entire city.
penthouse.exZh: 那位商人買下一間可俯瞰整座城市的頂層公寓。

people.ex: Many people now prefer to work from home a few days a week.
people.exZh: 現在許多人偏好每週在家工作幾天。

perceive.ex: Most visitors perceive the city as safe and welcoming.
perceive.exZh: 大多數遊客感知到這座城市安全又友善。

perceptive.ex: A perceptive teacher can quickly tell when a student is struggling.
perceptive.exZh: 敏銳的老師能很快看出學生什麼時候遇到困難。

perfect.ex: The weather was perfect for a picnic by the river.
perfect.exZh: 天氣好極了，很適合在河邊野餐。

performance.ex: The athlete's performance improved after he changed his training routine.
performance.exZh: 那位運動員改變訓練方式後，狀態有了進步。

perfume.ex: She chose a light floral perfume for the summer wedding.
perfume.exZh: 她為夏季婚禮挑了一款清淡的花香香水。

peril.ex: Climbers face constant peril when crossing the glacier.
peril.exZh: 登山者穿越冰河時，始終面臨危險。

perilous.ex: The perilous journey across the desert took nearly a month.
perilous.exZh: 橫越沙漠的危險旅程花了將近一個月。

perish.ex: Thousands of animals perished in the drought that struck the region.
perish.exZh: 這場襲擊該地區的乾旱導致數千隻動物喪生。

permanent.ex: Poor diet can cause permanent damage to a child's development.
permanent.exZh: 不良飲食可能對孩子的發育造成永久性的損害。

permeate.ex: The smell of fresh bread permeated the whole street.
permeate.exZh: 新鮮麵包的香味滲透了整條街。

perpetuate.ex: Some films perpetuate harmful stereotypes about older people.
perpetuate.exZh: 有些電影延續了對年長者的有害刻板印象。

perplex.ex: The strange results continued to perplex the research team.
perplex.exZh: 這些奇怪的結果持續讓研究團隊感到困惑。

persist.ex: Despite repeated failures, she persisted with her research on the disease.
persist.exZh: 儘管一再失敗，她仍堅持進行這種疾病的研究。

persistence.ex: Her persistence eventually helped her win a place at a top university.
persistence.exZh: 她的毅力最終幫她贏得了一所頂尖大學的入學資格。

persistent.ex: He is a persistent student who never gives up on difficult problems.
persistent.exZh: 他是個執著的學生，絕不放棄困難的問題。

personal.ex: Employees should not use company computers for personal business.
personal.exZh: 員工不應使用公司電腦處理私人事務。

personality.ex: Her warm personality makes her popular among her colleagues.
personality.exZh: 她溫暖的性格讓她在同事之間很受歡迎。

personally.ex: The director personally thanked every volunteer after the event.
personally.exZh: 活動結束後，主任親自感謝每一位志工。

perspective.ex: Travelling abroad gave him a new perspective on his own culture.
perspective.exZh: 出國旅行讓他對自己的文化有了新的視角。

pet.ex: Owning a pet can reduce stress and loneliness among elderly people.
pet.exZh: 養寵物可以減輕老年人的壓力與孤獨感。

pet cafe.ex: We spent the afternoon at a pet cafe playing with friendly cats.
pet cafe.exZh: 我們下午待在寵物咖啡館，和親人的貓咪玩耍。

petal.ex: A single red petal floated on the surface of the pond.
petal.exZh: 一片紅色的花瓣漂浮在池塘的水面上。

petite.ex: The petite dancer looked even smaller next to her tall partner.
petite.exZh: 嬌小的舞者站在高大的舞伴身旁顯得更矮小。

petrify.ex: The sound of footsteps behind him seemed to petrify the boy.
petrify.exZh: 身後的腳步聲似乎讓男孩嚇得僵住了。

petty.ex: They wasted hours arguing over petty details instead of the main plan.
petty.exZh: 他們浪費了好幾個小時爭論微不足道的細節，而不是主要計畫。

pharmaceutical.ex: The pharmaceutical industry invests heavily in research for new vaccines.
pharmaceutical.exZh: 製藥業在新疫苗的研究上投入了大量資金。

philanthropist.ex: The philanthropist donated millions to build schools in rural areas.
philanthropist.exZh: 這位慈善家捐出數百萬元，在鄉村地區興建學校。

philosophy.ex: She studied philosophy at university before becoming a journalist.
philosophy.exZh: 她成為記者之前，在大學主修哲學。

phobia.ex: His phobia of heights prevented him from visiting the observation tower.
phobia.exZh: 他的懼高症讓他無法上觀景塔。

phone.ex: Please turn off your phone before the lecture starts.
phone.exZh: 演講開始之前，請把你的電話關機。

phone number.ex: Could you write your phone number on the registration form?
phone number.exZh: 你可以把電話號碼寫在報名表上嗎？

photo.ex: We took a group photo in front of the old temple.
photo.exZh: 我們在古老的廟宇前拍了一張合照。

photograph.ex: The museum displays a rare photograph of the city taken in 1900.
photograph.exZh: 博物館展出了一張一九〇〇年拍攝的罕見城市照片。

photographer.ex: The photographer waited for hours to capture the perfect sunrise.
photographer.exZh: 攝影師等了好幾個小時，只為拍下完美的日出。

photography.ex: He took up photography after retiring from his teaching career.
photography.exZh: 他結束教職生涯退休後，開始學習攝影。

phrase.ex: The pianist repeated the opening phrase slowly to show the rhythm.
phrase.exZh: 鋼琴家緩緩重複開頭的樂句，以示範節奏。

physical.ex: Regular physical exercise improves both health and concentration.
physical.exZh: 規律的身體運動能增進健康和專注力。

physician.ex: The physician advised him to reduce salt and sugar in his diet.
physician.exZh: 醫生建議他減少飲食中的鹽和糖。

physiotherapist.ex: A physiotherapist helped him regain strength after the knee injury.
physiotherapist.exZh: 理療師幫助他在膝傷後恢復體力。

physique.ex: Years of swimming gave him a strong, athletic physique.
physique.exZh: 多年的游泳讓他擁有強壯而健美的體格。

piano.ex: She has played the piano since she was five years old.

pick.ex: Farmers hire extra workers to pick apples in early autumn.
pick.exZh: 農民在初秋會雇用額外的人手來採摘蘋果。

pick up.ex: He bent down to pick up the papers that had fallen on the floor.
pick up.exZh: 他彎下腰去拿掉在地上的紙張。

picky.ex: My younger brother is picky about food and refuses most vegetables.
picky.exZh: 我弟弟對食物很挑剔，大部分蔬菜都不肯吃。

pierce.ex: The needle managed to pierce the thick leather without difficulty.
pierce.exZh: 針毫不費力地刺穿了厚皮革。

pigment.ex: Ancient artists made pigment from crushed stones and plants.
pigment.exZh: 古代藝術家用碎石和植物製成顏料。

pigtail.ex: The little girl wore her hair in a pigtail tied with a red ribbon.
pigtail.exZh: 小女孩把頭髮綁成一條辮子，繫上紅色緞帶。

pile.ex: A pile of unread newspapers had built up beside the front door.
pile.exZh: 門口旁堆積了一堆沒讀的報紙。

pilot.ex: The pilot announced that the flight would be delayed by an hour.
pilot.exZh: 飛行員宣布航班將延誤一小時。

pin.ex: She used a small pin to hold the fabric in place.
pin.exZh: 她用一根小針把布料固定住。

pine.ex: The cabin was built entirely from local pine and smelled of resin.
pine.exZh: 這間小木屋全部以當地的松木建成，聞起來帶著樹脂香。

pitch.ex: The start-up founders will pitch their idea to investors next Monday.
pitch.exZh: 新創公司的創辦人下週一將向投資人進行路演。

pitiless.ex: The pitiless dictator ignored the cries of the starving population.
pitiless.exZh: 冷酷的獨裁者無視飢餓人民的哭喊。

pity.ex: Many people felt pity for the families who lost their homes in the flood.
pity.exZh: 許多人對在洪水中失去家園的家庭感到同情。

pivot.ex: The dancer managed to pivot on one foot and face the audience.
pivot.exZh: 舞者單腳轉身，面向觀眾。

pizza.ex: We ordered a large pizza with mushrooms and cheese for dinner.
pizza.exZh: 我們晚餐點了一個加蘑菇和起司的大披薩。

place.ex: The village is a quiet place to spend a long summer holiday.
place.exZh: 這座村莊是度過漫長暑假的安靜地方。

plagiarism.ex: Plagiarism is treated as a serious offence in most universities.
plagiarism.exZh: 在大多數大學裡，剽竊被視為嚴重的違規行為。

plain.ex: She preferred a plain white dress without any decoration.
plain.exZh: 她偏好沒有任何裝飾的樸素白色洋裝。

plan.ex: The council has a plan to build more cycling lanes in the city.
plan.exZh: 市議會有一項在城市增設更多自行車道的計劃。

planetarium.ex: The school took the pupils to the planetarium to learn about the stars.
planetarium.exZh: 學校帶學生去天文館認識星星。

plant.ex: This plant needs plenty of sunlight and very little water.
plant.exZh: 這種植物需要充足的陽光，而且只需要很少的水。

platform.ex: Passengers waited on the platform for the delayed evening train.
platform.exZh: 乘客們在月臺上等候延誤的晚班列車。

platinum.ex: Platinum is rarer and more valuable than gold or silver.
platinum.exZh: 鉑金比黃金或白銀更稀有，也更有價值。

play.ex: He learned to play the violin when he was only seven.
play.exZh: 他才七歲就學會了彈奏小提琴。

playboy.ex: The newspaper described the millionaire as a playboy who loved fast cars.
playboy.exZh: 報紙把那位百萬富翁形容成熱愛跑車的花花公子。

player.ex: Every player on the team trained hard before the championship.
player.exZh: 隊上每位球員在錦標賽之前都努力訓練。

playground.ex: The council plans to renovate the playground near the primary school.
playground.exZh: 市議會計劃翻修小學附近的遊樂場。

plea.ex: The charity made an urgent plea for donations after the earthquake.
plea.exZh: 地震過後，慈善機構緊急呼籲各界捐款。

plead.ex: The villagers pleaded with the government to build a new bridge.
plead.exZh: 村民們懇求政府興建一座新橋。

pleasant.ex: We spent a pleasant afternoon walking along the river.
pleasant.exZh: 我們沿著河邊散步，度過了愉快的下午。

plummet.ex: Property prices plummeted after the financial crisis hit the country.
plummet.exZh: 金融危機襲擊該國後，房價驟降。

plunge.ex: Share prices plunged by ten percent after the unexpected announcement.
plunge.exZh: 在這項出人意料的公告後，股價暴跌了百分之十。

pocket.ex: He put the receipt carefully in his coat pocket.
pocket.exZh: 他小心翼翼地把收據放進外套口袋。

poem.ex: Students were asked to memorise a short poem by Robert Frost.
poem.exZh: 學生被要求背誦一首佛洛斯特的短詩。

poet.ex: The poet read her latest work to a packed hall.
poet.exZh: 詩人在座無虛席的大廳裡朗讀她的最新作品。

poetry.ex: He published a small collection of poetry about life in the mountains.
poetry.exZh: 他出版了一本關於山中生活的小詩集。

point.ex: The guide pointed at the mountain and explained its history.
point.exZh: 導遊指著那座山，並講解它的歷史。

point out.ex: The teacher pointed out several errors in my essay.
point out.exZh: 老師指出了我文章中的幾處錯誤。

pointed.ex: The pointed roof of the tower could be seen from miles away.
pointed.exZh: 塔樓尖尖的屋頂從數英里外就能看見。

poise.ex: She answered the difficult questions with remarkable poise.
poise.exZh: 她以非凡的鎮定回答了那些困難的問題。

polaris.ex: Sailors once used Polaris to find their way across the sea.
polaris.exZh: 水手們過去利用北極星在海上辨別方向。

pole.ex: The flag hung from a tall pole outside the town hall.
pole.exZh: 旗幟掛在市政廳外一根高高的杆子上。

police.ex: The police asked witnesses to come forward with any information.
police.exZh: 警察請目擊者提供任何資訊。

polish.ex: He used a soft cloth to polish the silver until it shone.
polish.exZh: 他用柔軟的布把銀器擦亮到閃閃發光。

polished.ex: The company gave a polished presentation that impressed the investors.
polished.exZh: 這家公司做了一場精緻的簡報，讓投資人印象深刻。

polite.ex: Please be polite to customers, even when they are upset.
polite.exZh: 即使顧客很不高興，也請對他們保持禮貌。

politely.ex: He politely declined the invitation because of other commitments.
politely.exZh: 他因為有其他事務，禮貌地婉拒了邀請。

political.ex: Young voters are becoming more interested in political issues.
political.exZh: 年輕選民對政治議題越來越感興趣。

pollen.ex: Pollen in spring can trigger allergies in many people.
pollen.exZh: 春季的花粉會引發許多人的過敏。

ponytail.ex: She tied her hair in a ponytail before going for a run.
ponytail.exZh: 她跑步前把頭髮綁成馬尾。

porcelain.ex: The museum owns a fine collection of Chinese porcelain.
porcelain.exZh: 博物館擁有一批精美的中國瓷器收藏。

pork.ex: Pork is widely eaten in many parts of East Asia.
pork.exZh: 豬肉在東亞許多地方被廣泛食用。

portrait.ex: The gallery displayed a portrait of the queen painted in 1850.
portrait.exZh: 美術館展出一幅繪於一八五〇年的女王肖像。

position.ex: The chair is in the wrong position, so please move it closer to the window.
position.exZh: 這張椅子位置不對，請把它移到靠近窗戶的地方。

positive.ex: Having a positive attitude can help students cope with exam stress.
positive.exZh: 保持積極的態度能幫助學生應付考試壓力。

possess.ex: Few people possess the skills needed to repair such old machines.
possess.exZh: 很少有人擁有修理這種舊機器所需的技能。

postmark.ex: The postmark showed that the letter had been sent from Vienna.
postmark.exZh: 郵戳顯示這封信是從維也納寄出的。

postpone.ex: The organisers had to postpone the festival because of heavy rain.
postpone.exZh: 因為大雨，主辦單位不得不推遲音樂節。

posture.ex: Sitting with good posture can prevent back pain in the long run.
posture.exZh: 保持良好的姿勢坐著，長遠來看可以預防背痛。

potent.ex: The new drug is a potent treatment for severe infections.
potent.exZh: 這種新藥是治療嚴重感染的強效療法。

potential.ex: The region has potential risks of flooding during the rainy season.
potential.exZh: 該地區在雨季有潛在的洪水風險。

potter.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a tall vase with steady hands.
potter.exZh: 陶藝師用穩定的雙手把黏土塑成一個高花瓶。

pottery.ex: Visitors can see ancient pottery from the Neolithic period in the museum.
pottery.exZh: 參觀者可以在博物館看到新石器時代的古代陶器。

pottery wheel.ex: The students took turns using the pottery wheel in the art class.
pottery wheel.exZh: 學生們在美術課上輪流使用陶輪。

pour.ex: Water began to pour from the broken pipe in the ceiling.
pour.exZh: 水開始從天花板破裂的水管傾瀉而下。

pout.ex: The little boy began to pout when his mother refused to buy sweets.
pout.exZh: 媽媽不肯買糖果，小男孩便噘起嘴巴。

poverty.ex: Education is one of the best ways to escape poverty.
poverty.exZh: 教育是擺脫貧窮的最佳途徑之一。

power.ex: The president has the power to veto laws passed by parliament.
power.exZh: 總統擁有否決國會通過之法律的權力。

powerful.ex: A powerful storm destroyed hundreds of homes along the coast.
powerful.exZh: 一場強大的風暴摧毀了沿岸數百間房屋。

pr.ex: She works in PR and helps companies manage their public image.
pr.exZh: 她從事公關工作，協助企業經營公眾形象。

practice.ex: Burning waste in open fields is a harmful practice that should be banned.
practice.exZh: 在空地焚燒廢棄物是應被禁止的有害做法。

praise.ex: The teacher praised the students for their hard work on the project.
praise.exZh: 老師稱讚學生們在專案上的努力。

pray.ex: Many villagers gather at the temple to pray for good harvests.
pray.exZh: 許多村民聚集在廟裡祈禱豐收。

precarious.ex: The climbers were in a precarious position on the narrow ledge.
precarious.exZh: 登山者處在狹窄岩架上的危險處境。

precious.ex: Clean water is a precious resource in dry regions.
precious.exZh: 乾旱地區的乾淨水源是珍貴的資源。

precise.ex: Scientists need precise measurements to confirm the results of an experiment.
precise.exZh: 科學家需要精確的測量值來確認實驗結果。

precision.ex: The surgeon operated with great precision and skill.
precision.exZh: 外科醫生以高度的精確度和技巧進行手術。

predator.ex: The lion is a top predator in the African grasslands.
predator.exZh: 獅子是非洲草原上的頂級掠食者。

predict.ex: Experts cannot easily predict how the economy will change next year.
predict.exZh: 專家很難預測明年經濟會如何變化。

predictable.ex: The film was enjoyable, but the ending was far too predictable.
predictable.exZh: 這部電影很好看，但結局太容易預測了。

prefer.ex: Many commuters prefer cycling to driving in heavy traffic.
prefer.exZh: 許多通勤者在交通擁擠時偏好騎自行車而不是開車。

preference.ex: Customers showed a clear preference for eco-friendly packaging.
preference.exZh: 顧客明顯偏好環保包裝。

prejudice.ex: Employers must not allow prejudice to affect their hiring decisions.
prejudice.exZh: 雇主不可讓偏見影響他們的聘僱決定。

prepare.ex: Students should prepare carefully for the speaking test.
prepare.exZh: 學生應該為口說測驗做好充分準備。

preposterous.ex: The idea that the factory could finish in one day is preposterous.
preposterous.exZh: 工廠能在一天內完工的想法簡直荒謬。

prescribe.ex: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the throat infection.
prescribe.exZh: 醫生開了抗生素來治療喉嚨感染。

prescription.ex: You need a prescription to buy this kind of medicine.
prescription.exZh: 你需要有處方才能買這種藥。

presence.ex: The presence of the manager made the staff work harder.
presence.exZh: 經理的存在讓員工更加努力工作。

principle.ex: Honesty is a basic principle of good scientific research.

prioritize.ex: It is important to prioritize your tasks when time is limited.

privilege.ex: Access to clean water should be a right rather than a privilege.

promise.ex: He made a promise to visit his grandmother every weekend.
promise.exZh: 他承諾每個週末都去探望祖母。

propeller.ex: The ship's propeller was damaged when it hit a rock.
propeller.exZh: 這艘船的螺旋槳撞到礁石時受損了。

property.ex: Many young people cannot afford to buy property in the capital.

proportion.ex: A large proportion of the population lives in coastal areas.

proposal.exZh: 委員會批准了興建新社區中心的提案。

propose.exZh: 市長提議對塑膠袋課徵新稅以減少廢棄物。

prose.exZh: 評論家稱讚這位小說家清晰優雅的文筆。

prosecute.exZh: 當局決定起訴該公司非法傾倒廢棄物。

prosperous.ex: The town grew into a prosperous trading centre during the nineteenth century.
prosperous.exZh: 這座城鎮在十九世紀發展為鼎盛的貿易中心。

protagonist.exZh: 這部小說的主角是一位為正義奮鬥的年輕護理師。

protest.exZh: 數千名市民遊行，抗議燃料價格上漲。

protocol.exZh: 醫院人員處理傳染病時必須遵守嚴格的規定。

prototype.exZh: 工程師在封閉賽道上測試電動車的原型。

proud.exZh: 兒子贏得科學獎時，父母感到驕傲。

provence.exZh: 我們在普羅旺斯度過暑假，四周是一片片薰衣草田。

provide.ex: The school will provide free lunches for children from low-income families.
provide.exZh: 學校將為低收入家庭的孩子提供免費午餐。

provision.ex: The aid agency delivered provisions of food and clean water to the flooded town.
provision.exZh: 援助機構向受洪水侵襲的城鎮運送食物和乾淨水等物資。

prune.ex: Gardeners prune the rose bushes in early spring to encourage new growth.
prune.exZh: 園丁在初春修剪玫瑰叢，以促進新芽生長。

pruning.exZh: 定期修剪能讓果樹保持健康並多結果實。

pseudonym.exZh: 這位作家以筆名出版了她的第一部小說。

psychiatrist.exZh: 精神科醫生協助病人控制他嚴重的焦慮。

psychological.exZh: 孤獨可能對年長者造成嚴重的心理影響。

psychology.exZh: 她正在修讀心理學，以了解孩子如何學習。

purr.exZh: 她一摸貓的背，貓就開始呼嚕呼嚕地叫。

pursuit.exZh: 她追求醫學學位的過程花了近十年。

question.exZh: 有些科學家質疑這種新方法是否真的安全。

quiet.ex: The library is a quiet place where students can concentrate.

quieter.ex: The neighbourhood is much quieter at night than during the day.
quieter.exZh: 這個社區夜晚比白天安靜得多。

quirk.ex: One of her quirks is that she always eats breakfast at midnight.
quirk.exZh: 她的一個怪習慣就是總是在午夜吃早餐。

radiance.exZh: 晨光的光芒灑滿了整個山谷。

radiant.exZh: 新娘走過紅毯時看起來容光煥發。

read.exZh: 她喜歡在每天通勤的火車上讀小說。

reader.ex: The newspaper asks its readers to send in their opinions every week.
reader.exZh: 這份報紙每週邀請讀者寄來他們的意見。

ready.ex: The students are ready to begin the exam as soon as the bell rings.
ready.exZh: 鐘聲一響，學生們就準備好開始考試了。

real.ex: The film is based on a real event that happened in 1998.
real.exZh: 這部電影改編自一九九八年發生的真實事件。

real estate.ex: Real estate prices in the capital have doubled in ten years.
real estate.exZh: 首都的房地產價格在十年內翻了一倍。

realistic.ex: It is realistic to expect prices to rise slowly over the next year.
realistic.exZh: 預期物價在明年緩慢上漲是比較現實的。

reality.ex: The reality of living abroad is often harder than people expect.
reality.exZh: 現實中，在國外生活往往比人們預期的更困難。

realization.ex: The realization that she was lost made her panic.
realization.exZh: 意識到自己迷路了，讓她驚慌失措。

realize.ex: He suddenly realized that he had left his passport at home.
realize.exZh: 他突然意識到自己把護照留在家裡了。

really.ex: It is really important to drink enough water during hot weather.
really.exZh: 在炎熱的天氣裡喝足夠的水真的很重要。

rear.ex: The frightened horse began to rear on its hind legs.
rear.exZh: 受驚的馬開始用後腿直立起來。

rearview mirror.ex: Check the rearview mirror before you change lanes on the motorway.
rearview mirror.exZh: 在高速公路上變換車道之前，要先看後視鏡。

reason.ex: The main reason for the delay was the heavy snow on the runway.
reason.exZh: 延誤的主要原因是跑道上的大雪。

reassure.ex: The doctor tried to reassure the nervous patient before the operation.
reassure.exZh: 醫生在手術前試圖安慰緊張的病人。

rebuff.ex: The minister rebuffed the proposal to raise taxes on small businesses.
rebuff.exZh: 部長回絕了向小型企業增稅的提議。

rebuild.ex: Volunteers helped rebuild the school that was destroyed by the earthquake.
rebuild.exZh: 志工協助重建被地震摧毀的學校。

recall.ex: I can hardly recall what the teacher said in the first lesson.
recall.exZh: 我幾乎記不住老師在第一堂課說了什麼。

recede.ex: The flood waters slowly receded, leaving mud across the fields.
recede.exZh: 洪水慢慢退去，在田野上留下一層泥巴。

receive.ex: Applicants will receive an email confirming their interview time.
receive.exZh: 申請者將收到一封確認面試時間的電子郵件。

recent.ex: Recent studies suggest that sleep is vital for memory.
recent.exZh: 近期的研究顯示，睡眠對記憶至關重要。

receptionist.ex: The receptionist greeted visitors and handed them security passes.
receptionist.exZh: 前臺人員向訪客問好，並遞給他們通行證。

recipe.ex: She followed an old family recipe to bake the traditional cake.
recipe.exZh: 她照著一份家傳的老食譜烘焙傳統蛋糕。

recite.ex: Each child had to recite a short poem in front of the class.
recite.exZh: 每個孩子都必須在全班面前朗誦一首短詩。

reckon.ex: Nobody could reckon how much the storm would damage the harvest.
reckon.exZh: 沒有人能預料到這場風暴會對收成造成多大的損害。

reclaim.ex: Campaigners want to reclaim the old railway as a public footpath.
reclaim.exZh: 倡議人士想把這條舊鐵路奪回，作為公共步道。

recliner.ex: He fell asleep in his recliner while watching the evening news.
recliner.exZh: 他在躺椅上看晚間新聞時睡著了。

reclusive.ex: The reclusive author rarely gave interviews or appeared in public.
reclusive.exZh: 這位隱居的作家很少接受訪問或公開露面。

recognition.ex: Facial recognition software can identify people in a crowded station.
recognition.exZh: 臉部識別軟體可以在擁擠的車站裡認出人。

recognize.ex: I barely recognized my old classmate after twenty years.
recognize.exZh: 二十年後，我幾乎認不出我的老同學。

recommend.ex: The doctor recommended a daily walk to improve his heart health.
recommend.exZh: 醫生推薦每天散步以改善他的心臟健康。

reconcile.ex: After years of silence, the two brothers decided to reconcile.
reconcile.exZh: 沉默多年之後，兩兄弟決定複合。

record.ex: She bought a vintage record by a famous jazz singer.
record.exZh: 她買了一張著名爵士歌手的老唱片。

recover.ex: It took him six weeks to recover from the broken leg.
recover.exZh: 他花了六週才從腿部骨折中恢復過來。

recovery.ex: The patient made a full recovery within a month of the surgery.
recovery.exZh: 病人在手術後一個月內完全康復。

recreate.ex: The film tries to recreate daily life in ancient Rome.
recreate.exZh: 這部電影試圖重現古羅馬的日常生活。

recruit.ex: The hospital plans to recruit fifty new nurses this year.
recruit.exZh: 這家醫院今年計劃招募五十名新護理師。

red.ex: The leaves turn red and orange every autumn in the mountains.
red.exZh: 每年秋天，山上的樹葉都會變得紅紅橙橙的。

redeem.ex: He tried to redeem himself by working hard for the community.
redeem.exZh: 他努力為社區工作，想藉此救贖自己。

redemption.ex: The film tells a story of crime, guilt, and eventual redemption.
redemption.exZh: 這部電影講述了罪行、愧疚以及最終救贖的故事。

redesign.ex: The company decided to redesign its website to make it easier to use.
redesign.exZh: 公司決定重新設計網站，使其更容易使用。

reduce.ex: Cycling to work can reduce both traffic and air pollution.
reduce.exZh: 騎車上班可以減少交通擁擠和空氣污染。

reef.ex: The coral reef is home to thousands of species of fish.
reef.exZh: 這片珊瑚礁是數千種魚類的家園。

referee.ex: The referee blew the whistle to end the match.

reflect.ex: The calm lake reflected the mountains like a mirror.
reflect.exZh: 平靜的湖面像鏡子一樣倒映出群山。

reflection.ex: She stared at her reflection in the shop window.
reflection.exZh: 她盯著商店櫥窗裡自己的倒影。

refresh.ex: A cool shower can refresh you after a long day of travel.
refresh.exZh: 一整天的旅途之後，沖個涼水澡能讓人耳目一新。

refrigerator.ex: Store the milk in the refrigerator to keep it fresh.
refrigerator.exZh: 把牛奶放在冰箱裡以保持新鮮。

refuse.ex: The company refused to give refunds on sale items.
refuse.exZh: 公司拒絕為特價商品退款。

regain.ex: After the long illness, he slowly began to regain his strength.
regain.exZh: 經過長期生病後，他慢慢開始重獲體力。

register.ex: Students must register online before the course begins.
register.exZh: 學生必須在課程開始前線上註冊。

registration.ex: Registration for the summer course closes on the fifteenth of May.
registration.exZh: 暑期課程的報名在五月十五日截止。

regret.ex: He deeply regrets not studying harder when he was younger.
regret.exZh: 他很後悔年輕時沒有更努力讀書。

regular.ex: She is a regular at the local cafe and knows every waiter.
regular.exZh: 她是那家在地咖啡館的常客，認識每一位服務生。

regulate.ex: The government introduced laws to regulate the use of pesticides.
regulate.exZh: 政府推出法律來管理農藥的使用。

regulation.ex: New safety regulations require all workers to wear helmets on site.
regulation.exZh: 新的安全規定要求所有工人在工地都必須戴安全帽。

regulator.ex: The diver checked his regulator before going under the water.
regulator.exZh: 潛水員在下水前檢查了他的調節器。

rehabilitation.ex: Rehabilitation after a stroke can take many months of daily exercise.
rehabilitation.exZh: 中風後的康復可能需要數個月的每日運動。

reject.ex: The committee rejected the plan because it was too expensive.
reject.exZh: 委員會拒絕了該計畫，因為成本太高。

relationship.ex: A good relationship between teachers and parents helps children succeed.
relationship.exZh: 師長之間的良好關係有助於孩子成功。

relax.ex: Listening to quiet music helps me relax after a stressful day.
relax.exZh: 聽輕柔的音樂能幫助我在壓力很大的一天後放鬆。

release.ex: The zoo plans to release the rescued birds back into the wild.
release.exZh: 動物園計劃把獲救的鳥放回野外。

relentless.ex: The relentless rain made it impossible to continue the search.
relentless.exZh: 不停的雨讓搜索無法繼續進行。

reliability.ex: Customers value the reliability of trains that arrive on time.
reliability.exZh: 顧客重視準時抵達之列車的可靠性。

reliable.ex: Look for a reliable source of information when you write your essay.
reliable.exZh: 寫論文時，要找可靠的資料來源。

relic.ex: The museum displays a relic from the ancient temple of the city.
relic.exZh: 博物館展出一件來自該城古老廟宇的遺物。

relinquish.ex: The king decided to relinquish his throne in favour of his son.
relinquish.exZh: 國王決定放棄王位，讓位給兒子。

relocate.ex: The company will relocate its head office to a cheaper city.
relocate.exZh: 這家公司將把總部搬遷到租金較低的城市。

reluctance.ex: He showed great reluctance to leave the village where he grew up.
reluctance.exZh: 他很不捨得離開自己成長的村莊。

reluctant.ex: Many farmers were reluctant to change their traditional methods.
reluctant.exZh: 許多農民不願意改變他們的傳統方法。

remain.ex: Prices are likely to remain stable throughout the year.
remain.exZh: 價格全年很可能保持穩定。

remarry.ex: After being a widow for ten years, she decided to remarry.
remarry.exZh: 守寡十年後，她決定再婚。

remedy.ex: Honey and ginger tea is a popular home remedy for a sore throat.
remedy.exZh: 蜂蜜薑茶是治療喉嚨痛的熱門民間藥方。

remember.ex: Do you remember the name of the hotel where we stayed?
remember.exZh: 你還記得我們住過的那間飯店的名字嗎？

remind.ex: The alarm will remind you to take your medicine at noon.
remind.exZh: 鬧鐘會在中午提醒你吃藥。

reminisce.ex: The old friends sat together and reminisced about their school days.
reminisce.exZh: 老朋友們坐在一起，回憶他們的求學時光。

remote.ex: They live in a remote village that can only be reached by boat.
remote.exZh: 他們住在一個只能搭船抵達的偏遠村莊。

remove.ex: Workers had to remove the fallen tree from the road.
remove.exZh: 工人必須把倒下的樹從路上移除。

renaissance.ex: The Renaissance saw a great flowering of art and science in Europe.
renaissance.exZh: 文藝復興時期見證了歐洲藝術與科學的蓬勃發展。

rendezvous.ex: The two agents arranged a rendezvous at the station at midnight.
rendezvous.exZh: 兩名特工安排了在午夜於車站會面。

renew.ex: You must renew your passport before it expires next month.
renew.exZh: 你必須在護照下個月到期之前續簽。

renovate.ex: The family plans to renovate the old farmhouse over the summer.
renovate.exZh: 這家人打算在夏天期間翻新那棟老農舍。

renowned.ex: She is a renowned expert on marine pollution.
renowned.exZh: 她是知名的海洋污染專家。

rent.ex: Many students struggle to pay the monthly rent in big cities.
rent.exZh: 許多學生在大城市難以支付每月的租金。

reopen.ex: The museum will reopen next week after months of repairs.
reopen.exZh: 博物館在數個月的整修後，將於下週重新開放。

repair.ex: The mechanic needs two days to repair the damaged engine.
repair.exZh: 技師需要兩天才能修理好受損的引擎。

repay.ex: It will take him ten years to repay the loan for his house.
repay.exZh: 他需要十年才能還清房貸。

repeat.ex: Teachers often repeat key points so that students remember them.
repeat.exZh: 老師常常重複重點，讓學生記得住。

replace.ex: Many factories now replace workers with robots to cut costs.
replace.exZh: 許多工廠現在以機器人取代工人以降低成本。

replica.ex: The gift shop sells a small replica of the famous tower.
replica.exZh: 禮品店販售這座著名高塔的小型複製品。

reply.ex: She was too busy to reply to his message until the evening.
reply.exZh: 她太忙了，直到晚上才回覆他的訊息。

report.ex: The manager asked each team to report on its progress every Friday.
report.exZh: 經理要求每個團隊每週五報告進度。

reporter.ex: The reporter interviewed several survivors of the flood.
reporter.exZh: 記者採訪了幾位洪水的倖存者。

reputation.ex: The restaurant has built a reputation for excellent seafood.
reputation.exZh: 這家餐廳以出色的海鮮建立了良好的名聲。

request.ex: The library received a request for extra copies of the textbook.
request.exZh: 圖書館收到了增購這本教科書的請求。

rescue.ex: Rescue teams worked all night to save people trapped by the landslide.
rescue.exZh: 救援隊整晚工作，以救出被山崩困住的民眾。

research.ex: Scientists are carrying out research into new treatments for diabetes.
research.exZh: 科學家正在進行糖尿病新療法的研究。

researcher.ex: The researcher spent three years collecting data on bird migration.
researcher.exZh: 這位研究員花了三年時間收集鳥類遷徙的數據。

resentment.ex: Unfair pay caused deep resentment among the factory workers.
resentment.exZh: 不公平的薪資在工廠工人之間引起了深深的怨恨。

reserve.ex: Please reserve a table for six people at seven o'clock.
reserve.exZh: 請為六個人保留七點的位子。

reshape.ex: New technology continues to reshape the way people work.
reshape.exZh: 新科技持續重塑人們的工作方式。

resident.ex: The resident of the hospital checked on every patient before dawn.
resident.exZh: 這位住院醫師在天亮前巡視了每一位病人。

resign.ex: The minister decided to resign after the scandal became public.
resign.exZh: 醜聞曝光後，部長決定辭職。

resignation.ex: The director handed in his resignation after twenty years of service.
resignation.exZh: 主任在服務二十年之後遞出了辭呈。

resilience.ex: Children often show remarkable resilience after difficult experiences.
resilience.exZh: 孩子在經歷艱難的事情之後往往展現出驚人的韌性。

resilient.ex: Resilient communities recover quickly after natural disasters.
resilient.exZh: 有韌性的社區在自然災害後恢復得很快。

resist.ex: It is hard to resist buying snacks when you feel hungry.
resist.exZh: 肚子餓的時候很難抗拒買零食的衝動。

resolute.ex: She remained resolute in her decision to study abroad.
resolute.exZh: 她對出國留學的決定始終堅定不移。

resolution.ex: Her New Year resolution is to exercise three times a week.
resolution.exZh: 她的新年願望是每週運動三次。

resolve.ex: He made a firm resolve to finish his degree despite the difficulties.
resolve.exZh: 儘管困難重重，他仍下定決心完成學位。

resonate.ex: The speaker's message about family resonated with the entire audience.
resonate.exZh: 講者關於家庭的訊息引起了全體聽眾的共鳴。

resource.ex: Water is a limited resource that must be used wisely.
resource.exZh: 水是必須明智使用的有限資源。

resourceful.ex: A resourceful manager can find solutions even with a tiny budget.
resourceful.exZh: 足智多謀的經理即使預算很少也能找到解決辦法。

respect.ex: Students should show respect for their teachers and classmates.
respect.exZh: 學生應該尊重老師和同學。

responsibility.ex: Parents share the responsibility for teaching children good habits.
responsibility.exZh: 父母共同承擔教導孩子良好習慣的責任。

rest.ex: After the long hike, they stopped to rest by the river.
rest.exZh: 長途健行之後，他們停下來在河邊休息。

restaurant.ex: We booked a table at a small restaurant near the harbour.
restaurant.exZh: 我們在港口附近的一間小餐廳訂了位子。

restless.ex: The children grew restless during the long train journey.
restless.exZh: 孩子們在漫長的火車旅程中變得躁動不安。

restore.ex: Engineers worked for years to restore the historic bridge.
restore.exZh: 工程師花了數年修復這座歷史悠久的橋樑。

restorer.ex: The restorer carefully cleaned the old painting with a soft brush.
restorer.exZh: 修復師用軟刷小心翼翼地清潔那幅舊畫。

restrain.ex: The teacher tried to restrain her anger when the students misbehaved.
restrain.exZh: 學生行為不當時，老師努力克制自己的怒氣。

restructure.ex: The company had to restructure its departments to save money.
restructure.exZh: 公司不得不重組各部門以節省開支。

resume.ex: Please send your resume and a short cover letter by Friday.
resume.exZh: 請在週五前寄出你的簡歷和一封簡短的求職信。

resurface.ex: Old rumours about the company began to resurface last week.
resurface.exZh: 關於這家公司的舊傳聞上週開始重新出現。

retaliate.ex: The country threatened to retaliate if new taxes were introduced.
retaliate.exZh: 該國威脅，如果課徵新稅就要報復。

retire.ex: The famous footballer decided to retire from the national team.
retire.exZh: 這位著名足球員決定從國家隊退役。

retired.ex: My grandfather is retired and spends his days gardening.
retired.exZh: 我祖父已經退休，整天都在整理花園。

retort.ex: "That is not true," he retorted angrily.
retort.exZh: 「那不是真的。」他憤怒地反駁道。

retrain.ex: Many factory workers had to retrain as technicians after the closure.
retrain.exZh: 工廠關閉後，許多工人必須轉行當技術人員。

retreat.ex: The soldiers were forced to retreat when the enemy advanced.
retreat.exZh: 敵軍推進時，士兵們被迫撤退。

retrieve.ex: Divers managed to retrieve the lost box from the bottom of the lake.
retrieve.exZh: 潛水員成功從湖底把遺失的箱子收回。

return.ex: The borrowed books must be returned to the library by Friday.
return.exZh: 借來的書必須在週五前歸還給圖書館。

reunion.ex: The family reunion takes place in the countryside every summer.
reunion.exZh: 家族重聚每年夏天都在鄉下舉行。

reunite.ex: The charity helps to reunite refugee children with their parents.
reunite.exZh: 這個慈善機構幫助難民兒童與父母團聚。

reveal.ex: The survey revealed that many students sleep fewer than six hours.
reveal.exZh: 調查揭露許多學生睡眠不到六小時。

revenue.ex: The tourism industry generates huge revenue for the local economy.
revenue.exZh: 旅遊業為當地經濟創造了龐大的收入。

revere.ex: Many young people revere scientists who fight climate change.
revere.exZh: 許多年輕人尊崇對抗氣候變遷的科學家。

reverse.ex: The new policy reversed the decline in student enrolment.
reverse.exZh: 新政策逆轉了學生入學人數下滑的趨勢。

review.ex: The committee will review the proposal before making a final decision.
review.exZh: 委員會將在做出最後決定前審閱這份提案。

revise.ex: Students should revise their essays carefully before submitting them.
revise.exZh: 學生在繳交前應仔細修改自己的文章。

revitalize.ex: The government plans to revitalize the rural economy with new investment.
revitalize.exZh: 政府計畫以新投資振興農村經濟。

revoke.ex: The authorities revoked his licence after the serious accident.
revoke.exZh: 嚴重事故後，當局吊銷了他的執照。

reward.ex: The company offers a reward for employees who suggest useful ideas.
reward.exZh: 公司為提出實用點子的員工提供獎勵。

rhythm.ex: Regular exercise helps maintain a healthy daily rhythm.
rhythm.exZh: 規律運動有助於維持健康的日常節奏。

rhythmic.ex: The drummer tapped rhythmically on the table throughout the lecture.
rhythmic.exZh: 鼓手在整場演講中有節奏地敲著桌子。

rib.ex: He bruised a rib when he fell off his bicycle.
rib.exZh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來時瘀傷了一根肋骨。

rice ball.ex: She packed a rice ball for lunch before the hiking trip.
rice ball.exZh: 她在健行前帶了一個飯糰當午餐。

rice paper.ex: Traditional calligraphers often write on rice paper.
rice paper.exZh: 傳統書法家常在宣紙上書寫。

rich.ex: Rich countries should help poorer ones cope with climate change.
rich.exZh: 有錢的國家應該幫助較貧窮的國家因應氣候變遷。

ride.ex: Many commuters ride bicycles to work to reduce pollution.

superficial.ex: His knowledge of economics is rather superficial, so he needs more study.
superficial.exZh: 他對經濟學的了解相當表面，所以需要多加學習。

superior.ex: My superior approved the new budget for the research project.
superior.exZh: 我的上司批准了這個研究計畫的新預算。

supermarket.ex: The new supermarket sells locally grown organic vegetables.
supermarket.exZh: 這間新超市販售本地種植的有機蔬菜。

supermodel.ex: The supermodel supported a campaign against plastic waste.
supermodel.exZh: 這位超模支持一項反對塑膠垃圾的活動。

superpower.ex: Some stories describe a hero with the superpower of flight.
superpower.exZh: 有些故事描述一位擁有飛行超能力的英雄。

superstition.ex: Many sailors followed the old superstition that whistling brings wind.
superstition.exZh: 許多水手遵循吹口哨會招來風的古老迷信。

supervisor.ex: The supervisor checked the safety equipment before work began.
supervisor.exZh: 監工在開工前檢查了安全設備。

supper.ex: After a long hike, we enjoyed a light supper by the fire.
supper.exZh: 長途健行後，我們在火堆旁吃了一頓簡單的宵夜。

supplier.ex: The factory changed its supplier to reduce production costs.
supplier.exZh: 工廠更換了供應商以降低生產成本。

supply.ex: The government sent emergency supplies to the flooded villages.
supply.exZh: 政府把緊急物資送往被洪水淹沒的村莊。

support.ex: The charity receives strong support from local businesses.
support.exZh: 這個慈善機構得到當地企業的大力支持。

suppose.ex: Let us suppose that prices double next year; how would families cope?
suppose.exZh: 假設明年物價翻倍，家庭要如何應對？

suppress.ex: The government tried to suppress the spread of false information online.
suppress.exZh: 政府試圖壓制網路上假訊息的散播。

surface.ex: A whale suddenly surfaced near our small boat.
surface.exZh: 一隻鯨魚突然在我們的小船附近浮出水面。

surge.ex: A surge of anger spread through the crowd after the announcement.
surge.exZh: 公告發布後，一股憤怒的情緒在人群中湧起。

surgeon.ex: The surgeon explained the risks of the operation to the patient.
surgeon.exZh: 外科醫生向病人說明了手術的風險。

surgery.ex: He needed surgery to repair his damaged knee.
surgery.exZh: 他需要動手術來修復受傷的膝蓋。

surgical.ex: The hospital bought new surgical instruments for the operating room.
surgical.exZh: 醫院為手術室購置了新的手術器械。

surprise.ex: The sudden rise in interest rates came as a surprise to most investors.
surprise.exZh: 利率突然上升讓大多數投資人感到驚訝。

surprisingly.ex: Surprisingly, the old bridge survived the earthquake without any damage.
surprisingly.exZh: 出乎意料地，這座老橋在地震中毫髮無傷。

surrender.ex: After a long siege, the army was forced to surrender.
surrender.exZh: 經過長期圍困，軍隊被迫投降。

surround.ex: Tall mountains surround the small village on all sides.
surround.exZh: 高聳的山脈從四面環繞著這座小村莊。

surrounded.ex: The house is surrounded by a large garden full of native plants.
surrounded.exZh: 這棟房子被一座種滿原生植物的大花園環繞。

survey.ex: The ranger took time to survey the damaged forest from the hilltop.
survey.exZh: 護林員花時間從山頂巡視受損的森林。

survival.ex: The survival of many species depends on protecting their habitats.
survival.exZh: 許多物種的生存取決於保護牠們的棲息地。

survive.ex: Few plants can survive in such a dry climate.
survive.exZh: 很少有植物能在如此乾燥的氣候中存活。

survivor.ex: The sole survivor of the shipwreck was rescued after three days.
survivor.exZh: 這起船難唯一的倖存者在三天後獲救。

susceptible.ex: Young children are more susceptible to infections than adults.
susceptible.exZh: 幼童比成人更容易受到感染。

sushi.ex: Many people in Taiwan enjoy eating sushi on weekends.
sushi.exZh: 許多台灣人喜歡在週末吃壽司。

suspect.ex: Doctors suspect that the virus spread through contaminated water.
suspect.exZh: 醫生懷疑這種病毒是透過受汙染的水傳播的。

suspicious.ex: The security guard grew suspicious of the man carrying an unmarked bag.
suspicious.exZh: 保全人員對那個提著無標示袋子的男子起了疑心。

sustainable.ex: The city is investing in sustainable energy such as wind and solar power.
sustainable.exZh: 這座城市正投資風力與太陽能等可持續能源。

swallow.ex: The patient found it painful to swallow after the operation.
swallow.exZh: 病人術後覺得吞嚥很痛。

sway.ex: The tall trees began to sway gently in the evening breeze.
sway.exZh: 高大的樹木在傍晚的微風中開始輕輕搖曳。

sweat.ex: Runners were dripping with sweat after the marathon.
sweat.exZh: 馬拉松結束後，跑者們汗流浹背。

sweet.ex: The tea was too sweet, so I asked for less sugar.
sweet.exZh: 這杯茶太甜了，所以我要求少放糖。

sweetheart.ex: He affectionately called his granddaughter sweetheart.

sweetness.ex: The sweetness of ripe mangoes makes them popular in summer.
sweetness.exZh: 熟芒果的甜味使它們在夏天廣受歡迎。

swell.ex: His ankle began to swell soon after the fall.
swell.exZh: 摔倒後不久他的腳踝就開始腫脹。

swelling.ex: The doctor said the swelling would disappear within a few days.
swelling.exZh: 醫生說腫脹幾天內就會消退。

swift.ex: The government promised swift action to help flood victims.
swift.exZh: 政府承諾迅速採取行動幫助洪水受災者。

swirl.ex: Dust began to swirl in the air as the wind picked up.
swirl.exZh: 風變大後，灰塵開始在空中旋轉。

swiss.ex: Swiss watches are famous for their precision and quality.
swiss.exZh: 瑞士手錶以精準和品質聞名。

swollen.ex: After the insect bite, her hand became red and swollen.
swollen.exZh: 被蟲叮咬後，她的手又紅又腫。

symmetrical.ex: The architect designed a symmetrical building with identical wings.
symmetrical.exZh: 建築師設計了一棟兩翼完全相同、左右對稱的建築。

symptom.ex: A persistent cough can be a symptom of several illnesses.
symptom.exZh: 持續咳嗽可能是多種疾病的症狀。

synonymous.ex: In many people's minds, success is synonymous with wealth.
synonymous.exZh: 在許多人心中，成功等同於財富。

systematic.ex: The team carried out a systematic review of all the available data.
systematic.exZh: 研究團隊對所有可用資料進行了系統化的審查。

table.ex: She placed the documents on the table before the meeting started.
table.exZh: 會議開始前，她把文件放在桌子上。

tackle.ex: The council must tackle the problem of rising traffic congestion.
tackle.exZh: 市議會必須處理日益嚴重的交通壅塞問題。

tactfully.ex: He tactfully avoided mentioning the company's financial problems.
tactfully.exZh: 他巧妙地避免提及公司的財務問題。

tag.ex: Each suitcase must have a tag with the owner's name and address.
tag.exZh: 每個行李箱都必須附上寫有主人姓名和地址的牌子。

tail.ex: The dog wagged its tail when its owner returned home.
tail.exZh: 主人回到家時，狗搖著尾巴。

take.ex: She decided to take a small notebook on every field trip.
take.exZh: 她決定每次校外考察都帶一本小筆記本。

take back.ex: I want to take back the jacket because it is the wrong size.
take back.exZh: 我想把這件夾克拿回去退，因為尺寸不對。

take care of.ex: Nurses take care of patients day and night in the hospital.
take care of.exZh: 護理師在醫院日夜照顧病人。

take down.ex: The workers will take down the old signs before the festival begins.
take down.exZh: 工人將在節慶開始前把舊招牌取下。

takeout.ex: We ordered takeout because everyone was too tired to cook.
takeout.exZh: 大家都累得不想煮飯，所以我們叫了外賣。

takeover.ex: The takeover of the small airline was approved by regulators.
takeover.exZh: 這間小型航空公司的收購案獲得了監管機構的批准。

talent.ex: The school offers a program to develop young musical talent.
talent.exZh: 學校提供一項培養年輕音樂才華的計畫。

talk.ex: Students often talk about their plans for the summer holiday.
talk.exZh: 學生們常聊起他們暑假的計畫。

tall.ex: The tall building can be seen from almost anywhere in the city.
tall.exZh: 幾乎在城市的任何地方都能看到這棟高大的建築。

tamper.ex: Officials warned that anyone who tampers with the voting machines will be punished.
tamper.exZh: 官員警告，任何人篡改投票機都將受到懲處。

tan.ex: After a week at sea, the sailors were deeply tanned.
tan.exZh: 在海上航行一週後，水手們都曬得黝黑。

tangle.ex: The fishing lines began to tangle around the boat's propeller.
tangle.exZh: 釣魚線開始纏繞在船的螺旋槳上。

tap.ex: He tapped the shoulder of the man in front to get his attention.
tap.exZh: 他拍了拍前面那個人的肩膀來引起注意。

target.ex: The company's main target is to double its sales within two years.
target.exZh: 公司的主要目標是在兩年內讓銷售額翻倍。

task.ex: Our first task is to collect data on local water quality.
task.exZh: 我們的首要任務是蒐集當地水質的資料。

taste.ex: Visitors can taste local cheese at the weekend market.
taste.exZh: 遊客可以在週末市集品嚐當地的起司。

taxi.ex: We took a taxi to the airport because the train was delayed.
taxi.exZh: 因為火車誤點，我們搭計程車去機場。

taxi driver.ex: The taxi driver knew a shortcut that avoided the heavy traffic.
taxi driver.exZh: 計程車司機知道一條避開塞車的捷徑。

tea.ex: Tea is one of the most important exports of this region.
tea.exZh: 茶是這個地區最重要的出口品之一。

teach.ex: Parents should teach children to respect the environment.
teach.exZh: 父母應該教導孩子尊重環境。

teacher.ex: A good teacher inspires students to think for themselves.
teacher.exZh: 好老師會激勵學生獨立思考。

team.ex: The research team published its findings in a leading journal.
team.exZh: 研究團隊將成果發表在一份頂尖期刊上。

team building.ex: The company organised a team building weekend in the mountains.
team building.exZh: 公司在山上舉辦了一個週末團建活動。

teamwork.ex: Successful projects depend on effective teamwork.
teamwork.exZh: 成功的專案取決於有效的團隊合作。

teapot.ex: She poured hot water into the teapot and waited for the leaves to open.
teapot.exZh: 她把熱水倒進茶壺，等茶葉舒展開來。

tear.ex: A single tear ran down her cheek as she read the letter.
tear.exZh: 她讀信時，一滴眼淚順著臉頰滑落。

tease.ex: His classmates liked to tease him about his strange haircut.
tease.exZh: 他的同學喜歡拿他奇怪的髮型調侃他。

tech.ex: Many young graduates want to work for a tech company.
tech.exZh: 許多年輕畢業生想到科技公司工作。

technically.ex: Technically, the museum is open daily, but it closes for repairs this week.
technically.exZh: 嚴格來說，博物館每天都開放，但本週因整修而關閉。

technique.ex: Doctors are using a new technique to treat heart disease.
technique.exZh: 醫生正在使用一種新技術來治療心臟病。

technology.ex: Advances in technology have changed the way we study.
technology.exZh: 科技的進步改變了我們學習的方式。

teenager.ex: Many teenagers spend several hours online every day.
teenager.exZh: 許多青少年每天花好幾個小時上網。

teeth.ex: Brushing your teeth twice a day prevents decay.
teeth.exZh: 每天刷兩次牙可以預防蛀牙。

telephone.ex: The telephone was invented in the nineteenth century.

telescope.ex: Astronomers used a powerful telescope to observe the distant galaxy.
telescope.exZh: 天文學家用一架強大的望遠鏡觀測遙遠的星系。

television.ex: Television can be a useful tool for teaching foreign languages.
television.exZh: 電視可以是教授外語的有用工具。

tell.ex: Grandparents love to tell stories about their childhood.
tell.exZh: 祖父母喜歡講述自己童年的故事。

temper.ex: He has a quick temper and gets angry over small problems.
temper.exZh: 他脾氣很急，常為小事發怒。

temperament.ex: The dog's gentle temperament makes it ideal for families with children.
temperament.exZh: 這隻狗溫和的脾性使牠很適合有孩子的家庭。

temperamental.ex: The temperamental chef shouted at his staff whenever something went wrong.
temperamental.exZh: 這位暴躁的主廚一有差錯就對員工大吼。

temperature.ex: The average temperature has risen by one degree in the last decade.
temperature.exZh: 過去十年平均氣溫上升了一度。

temple.ex: Pilgrims climbed the hill to visit the ancient temple.
temple.exZh: 朝聖者爬上山丘參觀那座古老的寺廟。

temporarily.ex: The road has been temporarily closed for repairs.
temporarily.exZh: 這條道路因維修而暫時封閉。

temporary.ex: She found a temporary job at a bookshop during the holidays.
temporary.exZh: 她在假期找到一份書店的臨時工作。

tend.ex: Volunteers tend the community garden every Saturday.
tend.exZh: 志工每週六照料社區花園。

tender.ex: The nurse spoke in a tender voice to calm the frightened child.
tender.exZh: 護理師用溫柔的聲音安撫受驚的孩子。

tenderness.ex: The doctor treated the elderly patient with great tenderness.
tenderness.exZh: 醫生非常溫柔地對待這位年長的病人。

tense.ex: The atmosphere in the exam hall was tense and silent.
tense.exZh: 考場的氣氛緊繃而安靜。

tension.ex: Rising tension between the two countries worried the international community.
tension.exZh: 兩國之間日益升高的緊張局勢令國際社會擔憂。

tent.ex: We put up a tent beside the river and cooked dinner outside.
tent.exZh: 我們在河邊搭了一頂帳篷，並在戶外煮晚餐。

tentative.ex: The two companies reached a tentative agreement on the merger.
tentative.exZh: 兩家公司就合併案達成了初步的試探性協議。

term.ex: The loan must be repaid within a term of five years.
term.exZh: 這筆貸款必須在五年的期限內還清。

terminal.ex: Doctors told the family that his cancer was at a terminal stage.
terminal.exZh: 醫生告訴家屬，他的癌症已到了晚期。

terminate.ex: The company decided to terminate the contract after repeated delays.
terminate.exZh: 由於一再延誤，公司決定終止合約。

terrace.ex: The cafe has a terrace overlooking the harbour.
terrace.exZh: 這間咖啡館有一座可俯瞰港口的露臺。

terrible.ex: The storm caused terrible damage to coastal villages.
terrible.exZh: 這場風暴對沿海村莊造成了可怕的破壞。

terrify.ex: Public speaking used to terrify him before he joined the debate club.
terrify.exZh: 在加入辯論社之前，公開演講曾讓他害怕不已。

test.ex: The laboratory will test the water for harmful chemicals.
test.exZh: 實驗室將測試水中是否含有有害化學物質。

text.ex: The students analysed the text for its main arguments.
text.exZh: 學生們分析了這篇文字的主要論點。

textbook.ex: The new textbook includes many real-life examples.
textbook.exZh: 這本新課本包含許多真實生活中的例子。

texture.ex: Customers love the creamy texture of the local ice cream.
texture.exZh: 顧客喜愛當地冰淇淋滑順的口感。

thank.ex: I would like to thank everyone who supported our research.
thank.exZh: 我想感謝所有支持我們研究的人。

thaw.ex: The snow began to thaw as spring arrived.
thaw.exZh: 隨著春天到來，積雪開始消融。

theme.ex: The main theme of the conference was climate adaptation.
theme.exZh: 這次會議的主題是氣候調適。

theoretically.ex: Theoretically, the new battery could last twice as long as the old one.
theoretically.exZh: 理論上，這種新電池的續航力可以是舊電池的兩倍。

therapeutic.ex: Gardening can be very therapeutic for people suffering from stress.
therapeutic.exZh: 園藝對承受壓力的人來說可以非常有療癒效果。

therapist.ex: The therapist helped her overcome her fear of flying.
therapist.exZh: 治療師幫助她克服了對搭飛機的恐懼。

therapy.ex: Physical therapy helped him walk again after the accident.
therapy.exZh: 物理治療幫助他在意外後重新走路。

thermal.ex: Hikers wore thermal clothing to stay warm in the freezing mountains.
thermal.exZh: 健行者穿著保暖衣物，在冰冷的山區保持溫暖。

thick.ex: A thick fog hung over the harbour all morning.
thick.exZh: 整個早上，濃霧瀰漫在港口上空。

thin.ex: The air is thin at high altitudes, so climbers may feel dizzy.
thin.exZh: 高海拔地區空氣稀薄，所以登山者可能會頭暈。

think.ex: He paused to think before answering the interviewer's question.
think.exZh: 他在回答面試官的問題前停下來想了想。

thinner.ex: After months of illness, she looked much thinner than before.
thinner.exZh: 病了幾個月後，她看起來比以前瘦了很多。

thorn.ex: A thorn from the rose bush scratched his finger.
thorn.exZh: 玫瑰叢上的刺劃傷了他的手指。

thorough.ex: The inspectors carried out a thorough investigation of the factory.
thorough.exZh: 檢查人員對工廠進行了詳盡的調查。

thoroughbred.ex: The thoroughbred won the race by three lengths.
thoroughbred.exZh: 那匹純血馬以三個馬身的差距贏得比賽。

thread.ex: She pulled a red thread through the needle and began sewing.
thread.exZh: 她把一條紅線穿過針孔，開始縫紉。

threat.ex: Plastic pollution is a serious threat to marine life.
threat.exZh: 塑膠污染對海洋生物是嚴重的威脅。

threaten.ex: Rising sea levels threaten many low-lying islands.
threaten.exZh: 海平面上升威脅著許多地勢低窪的島嶼。

threatening.ex: The dark clouds looked threatening, so we cancelled the picnic.
threatening.exZh: 烏雲看起來很有威脅性，所以我們取消了野餐。

thrive.ex: Wild orchids thrive in warm and humid forests.
thrive.exZh: 野生蘭花在溫暖潮濕的森林裡生長茂盛。

throat.ex: Cold air can irritate your throat during winter runs.
throat.exZh: 冬季跑步時，冷空氣可能刺激你的喉嚨。

throw.ex: Fans began to throw flowers onto the stage after the concert.
throw.exZh: 演唱會結束後，歌迷開始把花扔到舞台上。

thumb.ex: He injured his thumb while repairing the bicycle.
thumb.exZh: 他在修理腳踏車時弄傷了拇指。

thunder.ex: We heard thunder in the distance before the rain began.
thunder.exZh: 下雨前，我們聽到遠處傳來雷鳴。

thunderous.ex: The speaker received thunderous applause at the end of the lecture.
thunderous.exZh: 演講結束時，講者獲得了如雷般的掌聲。

thwart.ex: Bad weather thwarted our plans to cross the mountain pass.
thwart.exZh: 惡劣的天氣挫敗了我們翻越山口的計畫。

ticket.ex: You can buy a train ticket online to save time.
ticket.exZh: 你可以在網路上買車票以節省時間。

tide pool.ex: Children found small crabs in the tide pool at low tide.
tide pool.exZh: 退潮時，孩子們在潮汐池裡發現了小螃蟹。

tie.ex: He used a rope to tie the boat to the dock.
tie.exZh: 他用繩子把船綁在碼頭上。

tighten.ex: The government plans to tighten rules on air pollution.
tighten.exZh: 政府計畫收緊空氣污染的規定。

tilt.ex: She tilted her head to listen to the soft music.
tilt.exZh: 她歪著頭聆聽輕柔的音樂。

time.ex: The runner improved her time by five seconds this year.
time.exZh: 這位跑者今年把成績提高了五秒。

time capsule.ex: Students buried a time capsule to be opened in fifty years.
time capsule.exZh: 學生們埋下一個五十年後才開啟的時光膠囊。

timeline.ex: The manager prepared a clear timeline for the construction project.
